question.text: Records of a Cat III AIF (AUM, valuation, strategies, investor details) must be maintained for at least:

answer.text: 5 years after winding up of the fund

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 3.3.1.2 mandates 5-year record retention after winding up. The Trap: Other periods are incorrect. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent across Cat I/II/III. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Cloud + physical backups recommended for 5-year retention.
